items.title: National Trust votes to seek new banking partner over Barclays fossil fuel ties
items.summary: Members of the National Trust voted overwhelmingly at its AGM to begin a competitive tendering process for its banking arrangements, citing concerns over Barclays' fossil fuel investments.

items.title: Nationwide introduces 5.3% fixed-rate bond for existing members
items.summary: Nationwide building society has launched a 30-month fixed-rate savings account paying 5.3% interest, restricted to its existing membership base.

items.title: Bank of England raises interest rates as inflation pressures mount
items.summary: The Bank of England has increased interest rates for the first time in over three years, raising borrowing costs for mortgage holders and credit card borrowers across the UK.

items.title: Nordea Bank faces potential $988 million penalty in Danish money laundering trial
items.summary: A Danish court is due to rule on Monday in a money laundering case involving Nordea Bank, where prosecutors are seeking a 6.6 billion-krone penalty.

items.title: IA Capital Group secures QBE backing for new fintech and insurtech fund
items.summary: IA Capital Group has confirmed the first close of its Inter-Atlantic Opportunity Fund I, anchored by QBE Insurance Group through QBE Ventures.

items.title: MEMIC Promotes Delcourt and Mather Joins Alliant
items.summary: The MEMIC Group has promoted Ben Delcourt to regional vice president of underwriting, while Tom Mather has joined Alliant Insurance Services as vice president.
